\section*{Score-II papers}
\begin{bankq}[id=SII02-P2-MATH-S1-Q05, source={Score-II - Test 02 (28 Mar 2021)}, paper=2, qno=5, type=multi, subtopic={Types of discontinuity}, answer={A,B,C}, answer_src=key, difficulty=8, diff_parts={K3 S1 I2 C2 F1}, diff_note={concepts: standard problem in this chapter, types of discontinuity, apply the relevant results | steps: apply the relevant results; compute}]
If $f(x)=\begin{cases}|x|-3 & x<1\\ |x-2|+a & x\ge1\end{cases}$ and $g(x)=\begin{cases}2-|x| & x<2\\ \operatorname{sgn}(x)-b & x\ge2\end{cases}$

and $h(x)=f(x)+g(x)$ is continuous $\forall\, x\in\mathbb{R}$ then which of the following options is/are incorrect

\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{Value of `a $-$ b' is 4}
\opt{B}{Value of `a $-$ b' is $-3$}
\opt{C}{Value of `a $+$ b' is 2}
\opt{D}{Value of `a $+$ b' is $-2$}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}
\begin{bankq}[id=SII18-P1-MATH-S2-Q07, source={Score-II - Test 18 (13 Feb 2024)}, paper=1, qno=7, type=multi, subtopic={Types of discontinuity}, answer={B,D}, answer_src=key, difficulty=8, diff_parts={K3 S1 I2 C2 F1}, diff_note={concepts: standard problem in this chapter, types of discontinuity, apply the relevant results | steps: apply the relevant results; compute}]
Let P, Q \& R be sets defined as following:
P = \{x : x is point of discontinuities of f(x)\},
Q = \{x : x is point of non-differentiabilities of f(x)\}
R = Q -- P.
f(x) = \{x\}$\times$\{ax\}$\sin b\pi x$, where a \& b are real constants (\{.\} denotes fractional part \& I denotes set of integers), which of the following option(s) is(are) CORRECT?

\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{For a = $-2$ \& b = 1, the set R = I -- \{0\}}
\opt{B}{For a = $-2$ \& b = 1, the set R = $\phi$.}
\opt{C}{For P = $\phi$ \& Q = I -- \{3n : n$\in$I\}, the set of values of a's is $\left\{-\tfrac13\right\}$ \& the set of values of b's is I -- \{0\}}
\opt{D}{For a = $-\tfrac15$ \& b = $-\tfrac13$, R = \{5n : n$\in$I\} $\cup$ \{3n : n$\in$I\} -- \{15n : n$\in$I\}}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}

\end{bankq}

Normal to the curve y = f(x) at (1, 1) is 3x + 4y = 7. Also $f(x)\geqslant\dfrac{4x-1}{3}$ for x $\geq$ 1 and $f(x)\leqslant\dfrac{4x-1}{3}$ for x $\leq$ 1. where f(x) is twice differentiable everywhere in its domain. Evaluate $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to1}\dfrac{3f'(x)-2f(x)-2x}{f(x)-x^2}$.
\end{bankq}
